about.title: About Software Factory Store
about.subtitle: Who we are and what we build.
about.body:
We are a premium commerce studio crafting reliable, beautiful shopping experiences for modern brands.

From curated catalogs to fast, secure checkout, every detail is engineered to help you buy with confidence — and to help great products find the people who love them.
